title: One on One with Marc and Ben

reader_summary.headline: Hi, everyone, and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, everyone, and welcome to the A16Z podcast. And this week, we're sharing two one-on-one conversations with Andresen Horowitz co-founders Mark and Ben, covering everything from company building to tech trends and culture. These originally took place as live chats on social audio app Clubhouse, where Ben and Mark now host weekly one-on-ones.

key_points.text: But we're sharing these first two episodes here, nearly three hours worth, where Bin and Mark cover everything from advice for founders.
key_points.evidence_quote: But we're sharing these first two episodes here, nearly three hours worth, where Bin and Mark cover everything from advice for founders, the evolving ways we work together remotely during the pandemic, and how to create great co-founder relationships to the future of major tech trends like decentralization, crypto, voice video and text, and much more.

thesis: The speakers discuss a framework for CEOs to operate in either 'wartime' or 'peacetime' modes depending on whether the company is growing steadily or facing a crisis requiring rapid directional change. They argue that while peacetime allows for maximum creativity and delegation, wartime requires a dictatorial, detail-oriented approach to pivot quickly, citing a pandemic-era example where a company chose to overpay for specific talent rather than retain everyone to survive.
